variant.description: Visual treatment — `default`, plus the state variants the input styles define.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the empty field. Defaults to `Search...`.

debounce.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing stops before searching. Defaults to `300` — lower feels faster and searches more often.

icon.description: Icon shown inside the field. Defaults to `🔍`.

clearable.description: Show a clear (×) control once there is text. On unless set to `"false"`.

loading.description: Show the busy indicator, for while results are being fetched. Bare attribute.

instant.description: Search on every keystroke, bypassing `debounce`. Bare attribute.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
